Thank you for your consistently courteous service.

This is a salon where I can leave my pet with peace of mind.

They accommodate my requests, and I receive many photos afterward, which I enjoy saving.

They also offer pick-up and drop-off services, so I can use their services even when I'm busy.

The prices are lower than other salons, and they provide detailed information about the pet hotel's condition, so I would like to continue using their services in the future.
They were very kind to me. Thank you very much 😊 …
